segments.name: Global Money Movement
segments.description: Digital cross-border financial services platform enabling customers to send money internationally and access related financial services.
segments.evidence: The substantial majority of our revenue is currently generated from our global money movement product, where we earn revenue from transaction fees charged to customers and foreign exchange spreads applied to the amount the customer is sending.
